summary: Frontend end-to-end verification of Pulse Service Desk PPM Create modal (SINGLE + BULK), Add-service-type flow, PPM segment button visibility (All/Commercial/MOD), and the new Service Desk → Equipment site-first customer/site multi-select with 'Log case for N machines' opening the pre-filled intake form. All primary UI flows pass; two non-blocking issues found (see below).

minor.issue: Returns duplicated organization_id rows for iso-demo-org (both 'Iso Demo Fitness (my org)' AND 'AlphaCo (Site A)' share organization_id=iso-demo-org). Causes React 'two children with same key: iso-demo-org' warnings in both ppm-create-customer and desk-eq-customer dropdowns. Duplicated key means one row is effectively unselectable/collapsed. Backend should dedupe by organization_id (or emit distinct row keys).

ui_bugs.issue: Uses organization_id as React key; when backend returns duplicates it triggers repeated console warnings and hides one row. Consider deduping client-side too (e.g. by unique key or filtering)

action_items: SEED FIX: scripts/seed_site_isolation_demo.py does NOT set is_service_desk=true on owner@isodemo.com — /api/auth/me returns is_service_desk:false so /service-desk redirects to /launch. Testing agent had to manually flip the flag in Mongo to reach the Service Desk. Update the seed to set is_service_desk=True on the owner (and/or manager) so future test agents and the customer demo can reach /service-desk out of the box.

BACKEND: dedupe /svc/desk/customers response by organization_id (currently returns two rows sharing organization_id=iso-demo-org, triggering React duplicate-key warnings in the new PPM Create modal customer picker and Equipment site-first customer picker).
OPTIONAL: guard against duplicate organization_id in the frontend selects (fallback safety).
critical_code_review_comments: PPMCalendar.js `CreatePpmModal` uses c.organization_id as <option key> — vulnerable to backend duplicates (currently triggering warnings). Same in DeskEquipment.js customer select.

PPMCalendar.js: `service` state in SchedulePpmModal defaults to 'Preventative Maintenance Service' but service types are loaded from /svc/ppm/services (legacy) while CreatePpmModal loads /svc/ppm/service-types — two sources of truth for the same concept. Consider consolidating.
test_credentials: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123!  (had to manually db.users.update to set is_service_desk=true before Service Desk was reachable — seed gap, see action_items)
seed_data_creation: Manually toggled is_service_desk=true on owner@isodemo.com in mongo users collection so /service-desk route grants access. Also created a TEST service type 'TEST Belt Tension Check' via /svc/ppm/service-types via the UI (should be cleaned up if seeds are reset).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Service Desk is at /service-desk (tabs via ?tab=maintenance and ?tab=equipment). The demo owner user needs is_service_desk=true or view_service_desk perm — otherwise the route bounces to /launch. Login endpoint is aggressively rate-limited (429 after ~3 rapid attempts) — space logins ~60s apart when scripting.
